description: List transactions with optional filters for contact, date range, payment mode, and entity source.

contactId.description: Contact ID to filter transactions by

endAt.description: End date for date range filter (ISO 8601)

entityId.description: Entity ID to filter transactions by

entitySourceId.description: Entity source ID to filter transactions by

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return

locationId.description: Location ID to filter transactions by

offset.description: Number of transactions to skip for pagination

search.description: Search query to match against transaction fields

startAt.description: Start date for date range filter (ISO 8601)

subscriptionId.description: Subscription ID to filter transactions by

name: crm_list_transactions
